- Can you confirm which Evergreen exec(s) will attend the Executive Briefing (EB) and any blackout dates for leadership in October/early November?
- Please flag any procurement gating items your team needs to close in parallel (I see an outstanding indemnity ask; cc'd procurement).

Next steps: if you can reply with availability by end of week, Ben and I will update the MAP and push a canary drop to your team.

Track B (Technical deep-dive, 60m): architecture diagram -> eval metrics -> performance demo -> Q&A

- Oct 11, 14:00–14:45 (Track A)
- Oct 11, 15:30–16:30 (Track B)
- Oct 14, 14:00–14:45 (Track A)
